foreground: Primary text and icons on `background`, `card` and `interactive-secondary`.
background: Page background of the main content area (`bg-background`); body default.
outer-background: App chrome behind the main content panel: sidebar area, mobile top bar.
interactive-secondary: Fill of secondary buttons, inputs, selects and chips — the raised control surface.
muted-foreground: Secondary text: body copy, form text and labels (`text-body`, `text-form-label`) on `background` and `card`.
tertiary-foreground: Tertiary text, the most-used text colour: captions, table cells, breadcrumbs, descriptions on `background` and `card`.
subtle: Quiet metadata text and icons (`text-body-secondary`), search hints. About 4.35:1 on `background` in Light and 3.98:1 in Dark, just under 4.5:1, so keep it to non-essential metadata and icons.
placeholder: Input placeholder text and disabled checkbox labels (2.3:1 Light, 3.2:1 Dark) — placeholder, never content.
sandbox: Sandbox or demo-company cues only (banner, badge). Purple, #8838ff.
primary: The one accent (#0077e6): primary button, selection, active borders, links, chart series 1, ::selection. Text on it is `primary-foreground`.
primary-foreground: Text and icons on `primary` fills (primary buttons).
hover-primary: Hover fill for selectable rows and checkboxes (a faint primary tint in light).
active-primary: Selected/open fill for selects and appearance options.
radio-group-hover-primary: Hover fill for radio-group area items.
border: Default 1px border for every element (`* { border-border }`): cards, inputs, dividers.
overlay: Surface of popovers, dropdown menus, selects and rich tooltips.
overlay-border: Border of popovers and menus on `overlay`.
overlay-separator: Separators and search-input dividers inside overlays.
overlay-hover: Row hover inside menus and option lists (translucent).
table-tray: Tray behind tables — the recessed band holding toolbar and table surface.
table-surface: The table body surface inside the tray.
input: Input and select borders (`input-base`); also Tailwind `border-input`.
switch-thumb-on: Switch thumb when the switch is on (sits on `primary`).
muted: Muted fills: skeletons, badges, inline code, quiet chips.
destructive: Destructive button fill and error borders. Light #e40000 is 4.7:1 on `background`; dark themes use a deep red fill (oklch 0.396) under white text and `destructive-foreground` for error text.
destructive-foreground: Text on `destructive` fills. Dark theme value is a light red used as error text on dark grounds.
error-text: Error and negative-amount text (`text-error-text`): 4.6:1 or better on `background` and `card` in Light, 6.5:1 in Dark. Use `destructive` only for fills.
input-background: Fill of long text inputs and the metadata editor.
card: Card and inline panel surface, toasts.
popover: shadcn popover slot — used by chart tooltips and analytics graphs.
secondary: shadcn secondary fill: chat panels, decision cards.
accent: shadcn accent fill — value chips, mobile top bar hover, menu highlight.
ring: Focus outline colour (`outline-ring/50` on every element).
chart-2: Sequential chart ramp step 2 (blue to purple).
chart-3: Sequential chart ramp step 3 (blue to purple).
chart-4: Sequential chart ramp step 4 (blue to purple).
chart-5: Sequential chart ramp step 5 (blue to purple).
chart-6: Sequential chart ramp step 6 (blue to purple).
chart-7: Sequential chart ramp step 7 (blue to purple).
chart-8: Sequential chart ramp step 8 (blue to purple).
chart-9: Sequential chart ramp step 9 (blue to purple).
chart-10: Sequential chart ramp step 10 (blue to purple).
chart-grid-stroke: Chart grid lines and axis rules.
chart-series-1: Categorical chart series slot 1 (blue). Order is colour-blind-validated: never reorder or skip.
chart-series-2: Categorical chart series slot 2 (orange). Order is colour-blind-validated: never reorder or skip.
chart-series-3: Categorical chart series slot 3 (green). Order is colour-blind-validated: never reorder or skip.
chart-series-4: Categorical chart series slot 4 (amber). Order is colour-blind-validated: never reorder or skip.
chart-series-5: Categorical chart series slot 5 (pink). Order is colour-blind-validated: never reorder or skip.
chart-series-6: Categorical chart series slot 6 (deep green). Order is colour-blind-validated: never reorder or skip.
chart-series-7: Categorical chart series slot 7 (purple). Order is colour-blind-validated: never reorder or skip.
chart-series-8: Categorical chart series slot 8 (red). Order is colour-blind-validated: never reorder or skip.
sidebar-primary: Primary accent inside the sidebar slot.
sidebar-accent: Hover/active fill in the sidebar slot.
color-muted-hover: Hover tint for muted, primary-tinted controls.
color-muted-active: Pressed tint for muted, primary-tinted controls.
color-yellow-600: Warning ramp: text on yellow washes.
color-yellow-700: Warning ramp: strong text on light washes.
color-code-background: Code block background (defined; Shiki sets its own).
color-code-bg: Alias of the code background (legacy name).
color-focus: Focus accent (violet) used by form focus effects.
color-error-light: Error wash behind destructive icon buttons.
input-border-hover: Input and select border on hover.
input-border-focus: Input and select border on focus and while open (`foreground` at 28%).
scrollbar-thumb: Scrollbar thumb on every scroll area (`foreground` at 20%).
color-zinc-50: Tailwind palette `zinc-50`, used by components: Badge `default` text, tag chips, tabs in dark.
color-zinc-100: Tailwind palette `zinc-100`, used by components: Badge `secondary` fill.
color-zinc-200: Tailwind palette `zinc-200`, used by components: Badge border.
color-zinc-300: Tailwind palette `zinc-300`, used by components: Neutral chrome in tag inputs.
color-zinc-400: Tailwind palette `zinc-400`, used by components: Neutral icons.
color-zinc-500: Tailwind palette `zinc-500`, used by components: Alert `default` tint (at 4% fill, 15% border).
color-zinc-600: Tailwind palette `zinc-600`, used by components: Neutral text in dark chips.
color-zinc-800: Tailwind palette `zinc-800`, used by components: Badge `secondary` fill in dark.
color-zinc-900: Tailwind palette `zinc-900`, used by components: Badge `default` fill.
color-zinc-950: Tailwind palette `zinc-950`, used by components: Deepest neutral in chips.
color-neutral-200: Tailwind palette `neutral-200`, used by components: PanelButton seams in light.
color-neutral-800: Tailwind palette `neutral-800`, used by components: PanelButton seams in dark.
color-stone-200: Tailwind palette `stone-200`, used by components: Warm neutral border.
color-violet-200: Tailwind palette `violet-200`, used by components: PanelButton selected ring.
color-violet-600: Tailwind palette `violet-600`, used by components: PanelButton selected icon.
color-violet-800: Tailwind palette `violet-800`, used by components: PanelButton selected, dark.
color-red-400: Tailwind palette `red-400`, used by components: Destructive menu item text in dark.
color-red-500: Tailwind palette `red-500`, used by components: Alert `destructive` tint, destructive menu items.
color-red-600: Tailwind palette `red-600`, used by components: Destructive menu item text in light.
color-blue-400: Tailwind palette `blue-400`, used by components: BetaBadge text in dark.
color-blue-500: Tailwind palette `blue-500`, used by components: BetaBadge tint.
color-blue-600: Tailwind palette `blue-600`, used by components: BetaBadge text.
color-sky-500: Tailwind palette `sky-500`, used by components: Alert `note` tint.
color-emerald-500: Tailwind palette `emerald-500`, used by components: Alert `success` tint.
color-amber-500: Tailwind palette `amber-500`, used by components: Alert `warning` tint.

panel-screw-selected: Screw dots on a selected PanelButton.
